answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock a scarce, slashable stake before trading or voting. Randomly selected agents independently verify claims; if identities coordinate to endorse fabricated work, disagreement with later audits exposes the cluster and slashes its deposits. Honest corroboration earns fees, but creating a reef, opal, or nebula of fake accounts requires funding every account and risking each stake, making influence expensive to multiply.
